gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-old-h: Noto Sans Old Hungarian keeps its tall a, e and s generously open, so tiny sizes stay readable. Funnel Display is all expressive twine, while the body simply keeps text legible.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-osman: Every stroke of Funnel Display is a smooth, pipe-like tube of uniform width. Its best trick is the tension against Noto Sans Osmanya, whose big lowercase and gentle s curves relax everything.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-runic: Expressive twine-like strokes of one width define Funnel Display, pressed flat into the page. But Noto Sans Runic's big x-height gives text a full, steady run, its curves staying open.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-samar: Noto Sans Samaritan reads sturdy and approachable, with generous daylight inside its curves. Funnel Display is best at expressive, neon-tube lines of constant width, while the body is best at holding hefty, legible text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-shara: Wire-cut letterforms, every stroke the same weight, give Funnel Display its commanding edge. Noto Sans Sharada brings bulky lowercase and open c forms underneath, so the expressive heading gets a sturdy, clean partner to lean against.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-sinha: Single-stroke brush lettering, that's Funnel Display, holding constant width from start to finish. Noto Sans Sinhala is where the thick, dark lowercase stripe does its steady work, leaving the heading to be the showpiece.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tai-l: Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its ink strokes before they touch. Funnel Display builds each letter from one stroke width, and the body can be sized up a notch for comfort beside it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tai-t: Pure spaghetti-line drama, that's Funnel Display, with crossbars matching its stems. Noto Sans Tai Tham keeps its chalkboard lowercase close under the capital line, so extended text settles into steady, readable rows.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Tiled, futuristic and flat in weight, Audiowide lays out every glyph like a tile with wide grout lines. Noto Sans Warang Citi can be sized up, its words forming solid blocks.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-no: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never pinches its letters shut, and its pronounced x-height gives it presence. Noto Sans Old North Arabian holds paragraphs in a dense, tall band.
